source.subject: prefill: add G2 D2 large-M candidate
source.measurement_source_note: The G2/D2 implementation and alias repair were measured from the working tree above f69f4d5. Commit 8889de4 records that measured implementation; changes between measurement and the milestone were comments and a host regression test, not execution code. measurement_tree_clean remains false and the exact measured binary identity is frozen below.

pre_measurement_admission_repair.failure: GateUpG2 returned cudaErrorInvalidValue before a performance result existed.
pre_measurement_admission_repair.root_cause: The original fused G2 output was bound to mlp.activated_bf16, which intentionally aliases mlp.normalized_input_bf16 in the layer-major request plan. In-place G2 would create a cross-CTA read/write race.
pre_measurement_admission_repair.repair: Bind the fused G2 output and D2 input to the exact-size dead mlp.gate_bf16 span and validate that it does not alias normalized input.

clean_host_preflight.jetson_idle_authority: tegrastats plus CPU/process and GPU-device-handle inspection

cross_boundary.interpretation: The negative direction is inside Prefill; API transport, queueing, admission, finalization, and Decode are not the active bottleneck.

bounded_nsys.capture: cuda,nvtx; no CPU sampling/context switches; CUDA Graph nodes; NVTX q3x.generation
bounded_nsys.interpretation: G2/D2 removed the standalone SiLU and fused the Down residual, but their combined role time was still 7.040160 s above the retained native Marlin main plus SiLU scope. Other kernels recovered 0.929762 s, leaving a 6.110398-s whole-GPU-kernel regression. Launch fusion and two-CTA resource admission did not create the persistent cross-CTA B/scale reuse needed to beat the retained route.

gate_up.topology: M128 x paired Gate64+Up64 x K64 raster
gate_up.epilogue: fused SiLU(gate)*up to BF16 activated output

down.epilogue: fused in-place residual add under the existing BF16 boundary

candidate_kernel_contract.structural_result: Meeting the static two-CTA/SM resource envelope was necessary but insufficient. Each CTA still owns and exits one output raster tile, so B/scale decode is not retained across CTA tiles.
candidate_kernel_contract.request_state_workspace_identity: The RequestState mlp_tactic remains the conservative three-span workspace-reservation identity. It is not the physical execution decomposition of this candidate.
candidate_kernel_contract.fused_execution_authority: The target-prefill-witness-v8 DeploymentPlan and request counters, not the conservative workspace tactic name, attest fused Gate+Up+SiLU and fused Down+residual execution.
candidate_kernel_contract.planner_layout_enum_decision: The route is rejected and default-off, so no new planner layout enum is added solely to rename reservation storage for a closed path.

p60_geometry_gate.reason: The rejected G2/D2 v1 would fail closed on the M5424 tail. P60 was neither timed nor used to judge speed; a future P40-competitive successor must add an exact M5424/general-tail route before P60.

decision.reason: The complete real API package regressed pure Prefill latency by 5.560464% and throughput by 5.267563% against the retained native direction. Bounded NSys shows G2+D2 7.040160 s slower than the retained native Marlin main plus SiLU role scope and total GPU kernel time 6.110398 s higher.
decision.next_step: Close this CTA-raster v1. Redesign the complete Gate/Up and Down ownership skeleton around persistent cross-row or cross-tile B/scale residency, freeze the future M5424/general-tail dispatch contract, implement M8192/M7712 first, and return directly to the clean real P40K API witness. Only a competitive, accuracy-admissible P40 result unlocks M5424 implementation and P60.

honesty_notes: The EvalScope result is one clean-host real-API direction sample, not a repetition-qualified release baseline.

The exact measured binary is pinned, but it was built from a dirty working tree above f69f4d5. Commit 8889de4 records the measured implementation; post-measurement changes before that milestone were comments and a host regression test, not execution code.
The matching first token is an API/output smoke observation only and does not qualify full numerical state or model capability.

RequestState's conservative three-span mlp_tactic describes workspace reservation only; the v8 DeploymentPlan/witness is the authority for the fused physical route. No dead-path planner layout enum is added for this rejected candidate.
The bounded NSys result diagnoses the already rejected direction and cannot reverse the P40 decision.
P60 was not run because the current candidate lacks M5424. This is a geometry/admission blocker, not a P60 performance result.
All generated evidence stays under the ignored repository .q3x-work tree; the model directory and user environments were read-only.
